short.q: Describe two features of relief shown by contour lines on a map.
short.model: Contours close together show a steep slope. Widely spaced contours show gentle slopes, and V-shaped contours show valleys.

short.q: Explain how to read a six-figure grid reference.
short.model: Read the easting first, using the third digit for tenths along the square, then the northing with the sixth digit for tenths up.
points: tenths for third and sixth digits

short.q: State two ways to present fieldwork data and when each is useful.
short.model: A line graph shows change with distance, e.g. river width downstream. A scatter graph shows the relationship between two variables.

short.q: Explain why a stratified sample may be better than a random one in a questionnaire.
short.model: It ensures each age group is represented in proportion, so the sample is less biased and more representative.

short.q: Suggest two ways to improve the reliability of beach pebble measurements.
short.model: Measure a larger sample of pebbles at each site. Use the same person and method each time and repeat at more sites.
